notes: Positions are the publication's location of each excavation area on the tell: Area C 'western slope' (pp. 127, 130); Area M 'northern part of the tell' (p. 155); Area K 'opened in the north' (p. 128); Area D 'northeast' (pp. 128, 140); Area H 'Danish northwestern sector' (p. 142); Danish 'southern sector' (p. 125); Area E 'about 50 m. east of the summit' (p. 157), summit taken as the unit itself. No plan position: Fig. 2 (general plan) has no north arrow and no national grid, and the area plans (Figs. 3, 7-12) cannot be tied to the unit's recorded point (map ref. 1775/1626). s4f4 and s4f5 rest on the plans (key 'IRON AGE I', labels 1400 and 1207) and the packet's caption notes naming them silos; the text excerpts do not describe them. s4f6 comes from text printed on the Fig. 8 page image (p. 150). s4f8: pool_def 'no' because the publication gives 1.25 m diameter. Not coded: 'Ein Seilun 'about 900 m. to the northeast' (p. 125) is described only as a spring, with no pool or basin; the Byzantine round plastered two-compartment industrial installation in Area C (p. 139) and the Area D drainage channel (p. 141) are not pools, pits or graves. The report has no passage on graves or tombs; that is silence, not an absence statement.
